(select `appointment_date` as `date`, "appointment" as type, CONCAT(
COALESCE(owner_name, 'Unknown Owner'),
' - ',
reason_for_visit,
' at ',
TIME_FORMAT(appointment_time, '%h:%i %p')
) as description, `created_at` from `appointment` where `appointment_date` between '2025-01-29 03:04:45' and '2025-02-05 03:04:45' and `appointment`.`deleted_at` is null) union (select CURRENT_DATE as date, "low_stock" as type, CONCAT(
name,
' - Only ',
quantity,
' items remaining'
) as description, `updated_at` as `created_at` from `products` where `quantity` <= quantity_alert and `quantity` > 0) union (select CURRENT_DATE as date, "out_of_stock" as type, CONCAT(
name,
' is out of stock'
) as description, `updated_at` as `created_at` from `products` where `quantity` = 0) union (select DATE(created_at) as date, "new_product" as type, CONCAT(
name,
' - ',
COALESCE(selling_price, 0),
' PHP'
) as description, `created_at` from `products` where date(`created_at`) = '2025-01-29') union (select DATE(created_at) as date, "new_pet" as type, CONCAT(
name,
' - ',
COALESCE(breed, 'Unknown Breed'),
CASE
WHEN age IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(', ', age, ' years old')
ELSE ''
END
) as description, `created_at` from `pets` where `created_at` between '2025-01-22' and '2025-01-29' and `pets`.`deleted_at` is null) union (select DATE(created_at) as date, "new_pet_owner" as type, CONCAT(
name,
CASE
WHEN email IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' - ', email)
ELSE ''
END
) as description, `created_at` from `users` where `role` = 'pet_owner' and `created_at` between '2025-01-22' and '2025-01-29' and `users`.`deleted_at` is null) union (select DATE(created_at) as date, "new_order" as type, CONCAT(
'Order #',
invoice_no,
' - ',
COALESCE(total, 0),
' PHP'
) as description, `created_at` from `orders` where `created_at` between '2025-01-22' and '2025-01-29' and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null) order by `date` desc, `created_at` desc

'Owner: ', owner_name,
'
Pet: ', COALESCE(pet_name, 'Not specified'),
'
Time: ', TIME_FORMAT(appointment_time, '%h:%i %p'),
